title: Noisy influence is dominated by influence
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, let $i\in[n]$ be a coordinate, and let $\rho\in\bbr$ satisfy $0\le\rho\le 1$. Then the noisy influence of $i$ on $f$ at noise rate $\rho$ is at most the influence of $i$ on $f$:
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i^{\rho}[f]\;\le\;\mathrm{Inf}_i[f].
\]
replaced:
For $0 \le \rho \le 1$ we have
$\mathrm{Inf}_i^{\rho}[f] \le \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$ for every coordinate $i$.
